text:
infra-monitor: ALERT: control-plane heartbeats dropped for eu-west-3. API returning 503s, 95% node heartbeats missing. auto-escalation threshold hit.

maria: taking incident command. oncall — please confirm this is not a false positive and tag support.

oncall (ops-bot): ack. creating incident channel #inc-2045678901 and paging cloud-support.

jon: seeing the same from edge: LB 502/503 spikes. `kubectl --context=eu-west-3 get nodes --no-headers` => 3 Ready / 48 NotReady. kube-api 503 on probes.

deploy-bot: recent control-plane deployment 2026-03-18T08:58:21 completed for cluster-euw3

ekaterina: autoscaler logs show repeated `QUOTA_EXCEEDED: GPUs unavailable` when trying to spin replacement nodes. Also VPC IP exhaustion on subnets.

maria: immediate mitigations: 1) pause deployments to eu-west-3 2) set routing policy to remove eu-west-3 from primary pool 3) start cross-region failover to eu-west-1/us-west-1. kyle, can you execute traffic shift?

kyle: starting change. will shift 65% -> eu-west-1, 25% -> us-west-1, leave 10% for degraded fallback. running: `infractl route update --origin eu-west-3 --weights eu-west-1=65,us-west-1=25,fallback=10`

kyle: update: DNS/edge policy applied, traffic steering at CDN layer in progress (propagation ~30s). monitoring.. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jon: confirming decrease in 503s at edge for incoming requests. internal mTLS to some model shards still failing though.

ekaterina: trying manual provisioning in eu-west-1 to absorb GPU load. hit cloud quota on GPUs (requested increase but provider responding with delay). opened cloud support ticket #CS-882334. ETA 40-60m.

sara: prepping customer comms. which tenants are affected? any Dedicated customers on eu-west-3 reserved pools?

ekaterina: two Dedicated customers have capacity pinned to eu-west-3 (cust-a, cust-b). we've queued cross-region migration but need approvals.

maria: prioritize Dedicated SLAs: start controlled migration for cust-a first. notify sales + success. sara please draft a short status note: cause, mitigation, ETA.

sara: drafting now. will post to status.redwood and email top 10 tenants in eu-west-3.

jon: quick health check snippet: ```
# from maintenance host
curl -sv https://api.eu-west-3.internal/health
* Connected to api.eu-west-3.internal
< HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
< Retry-After: 30
{"status":"degraded","components":{"control-plane":"unreachable","kube-api":"503"}}
```

ekaterina: note — KV cache invalidation observed during partial failover attempts. some prefixes lost causing token cache misses. working on rehydration script.

maria: cost note: cross-region GPU spill will increase spend. ekaterina, estimate for 24h of eu-west-1 GPU absorption?

ekaterina: rough: +28-35% infra spend if we keep high-capacity models running cross-region. we can mitigate by selectively downgrading non-critical routes to quantized variants.

maria: do that for background jobs and non-prod traffic. maintain fidelity for SLAs.

ops-bot: provider ticket #CS-882334 updated: "investigating control-plane networking incident affecting eu-west-3. Next update in 45m."

jon: I've started a rolling restart of the API proxies in eu-west-3 to clear stale connections (paused further restarts pending provider update).

kyle: traffic weights now: eu-west-1 65, us-west-1 25, fallback 10. observed request rate shift and tail latency in eu-west-1 up ~12ms.

sara: status note ready, posting to status page and sending email to affected customers with contingency steps.

maria: OK team — continue monitoring. ekaterina keep cloud-support engaged for quota and control-plane root cause. jon/kyle keep observing routing and health. I'll update exec and on-call rotation in 30m.

infra-monitor: Auto-alert cleared for eu-west-3 heartbeats (fluctuating). will re-alert on recurrence.

maria: incident is active. next checkin + timeline update at 2045679201. :white_check_mark:
